theorem _root_.CompressionEval.lib_number_theory_pilot_nat_basic_06 {C : ℕ → Sort*} {n m} (hnm : n ≤ m) (next : ∀ {k}, C k → C (k + 1))
    (Hnext : ∀ n, Injective (@next n)) :
  Injective (@leRecOn C n m hnm next) :=
by
  induction hnm with
  | refl =>
    intro x y H
    rwa [leRecOn_self, leRecOn_self] at H
  | step hnm ih =>
    intro x y H
    rw [leRecOn_succ hnm, leRecOn_succ hnm] at H
    exact ih (Hnext _ H)
